overclaims: CNBC reported on November 6, 2023 that Cruise said its cars initiated remote-assistance requests roughly every four to five miles during the service paused in October 2023 (e1).
checks.note: Only the CNBC headline supports 'every four to five miles', and it says 'rely on human assistance', not 'initiated requests'. The contract requires keeping those two apart. Nothing in the evidence shown places that rate in the service paused in October, or says some requests resolved automatically. The public excerpt 'remotely assisted (RA) 2-4%' cuts the quote down and drops 'of the time on average, in complex urban environments'. The rationale also cites e1 for the per-mile figure while the excerpt shown is the 2–4% figure.
